description:
After more than a decade of relentless R&D in oversized wheel bikes—starting with 36” wheels in 2013 and pioneering the 32” category since 2016—DirtySixer introduces the MonsterEnduro 32, the fourth model built around our “Point Guard” wheel size.
Designed from the ground up for tall riders, this full-suspension 32er delivers stability, speed, and confidence that simply can’t be achieved with undersized frames and wheels.
Designed for Tall Riders — No Compromises
DirtySixer is the driving force behind proportionate bicycles for tall people.Our bikes are not adapted versions of standard designs—they are engineered correctly from the start.
True big-wheel geometry for tall riders
Frames significantly larger than typical XL or XXL bikes
Developed with feedback from tall professional athletes
The MonsterEnduro 32 is built for riders from 170 cm / 5’6” and up (Size L)—with larger sizes extending far beyond what mainstream brands offer.
MonsterEnduro 32 Highlights
32” Wheels: Faster, Smoother, More Stable
Big wheels roll faster, carry momentum better, and reduce the need for excessive suspension travel. On 32” wheels, obstacles feel smaller and lines become easier to hold—especially for tall riders.
Updated Maxxis Dissector 2.40 – 32”
Optimized rollover and traction at speed
Race-tested at Megavalanche 2026
Advanced Suspension Platform
Engineered with a veteran Taiwanese suspension designer, the MonsterEnduro 32 uses a 4-bar Horst link kinematic for predictable performance under braking and hard charging.
Approx. 140 mm rear travel
Approx. 140 mm front travel (final spec TBD)
Modified Manitou Dorado fork with custom DirtySixer CNC crowns
Bigger wheels don’t need excessive travel—efficiency and control come naturally.
Overbuilt Frame for Real-World Abuse
Every DirtySixer frame is designed to outlast trends—and crashes.
Built to handle aggressive riding and heavy loads
Tested extensively by tall riders and professional athletes
Drivetrain, Brakes & Control
SRAM Eagle 90 drivetrain
Magura Louise 4-piston brakes
200 mm rotors front & rear
Massive stopping power for bigger wheels and faster speeds
Tall-Rider-Specific Ergonomics
T47 Fat Bike bottom bracket with inboard bearings
Ultra-narrow 186 mm Q-factor (exceptional for a 197mm rear hub bike)
2-piece cranks with 30 mm steel axle
Crank length increases with frame size
Chainstay length scales with frame size for proper balance
34.9 mm seat tube compatible with 200+ mm dropper posts
Wheelsets & Tire Protection
We’ve tested multiple carbon rim options, but production bikes may feature DirtySixer-designed aluminum rims, developed from our e-bike program:
Triple-wall construction
Offset & angled spoke drilling
Anti–snake bite profile
Built specifically for 32” (and 36”) wheels
We are also working with leading brands on custom inserts adapted to 32” and 36” diameters for racing and aggressive riding.
Geometry (Prototype – Final Numbers TBD)
The current prototype (approx. size XL) will continue evolving through testing.
Final geometry charts will be published prior to production.
Available Sizes
The MonsterEnduro 32 will be available in five true tall-rider sizes:
L
XL
2XL
3XL
4XL
Note: Specifications, geometry and aesthetics are subject to evolve before production
Price does not include shipping or local taxes. Shipping fee will be due at the time of shipping.
Pre-Order Offers
30% discount for full upfront payment
Built by the Leaders in Big-Wheel Bikes
With more than a decade of experience designing and fabricating oversized bicycles—and continuous feedback from tall professional riders—the DirtySixer 32” lineup represents a colossal leap forward in performance, consistency, and reliability.
The MonsterEnduro 32 follows the same over-engineered philosophy that defines every DirtySixer bike:
No shortcuts. No compromises. Built for tall riders first.
